raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

In DeepSeek-V4.1 Mega attention decode, wqkv_a and wo_b quantize their bf16 input in a separate kernel before the MXFP8 GEMM. The producers of those inputs (Mega-mHC and the wo_a `fp8_einsum`) can write the MXFP8 input directly.

## Modifications

- `LinearBase.deepgemm_mxfp8_input`: `MQALayer` sets it on wqkv_a and wo_b before load; `Fp8LinearMethod.process_weights_after_loading` packs a DeepGEMM weight scale beside the FlashInfer one and keeps the flag only when it did. A DeepGEMM-packed activation pair is a plain `(fp8, int32 scale)` tuple, which `apply` routes to the existing `deepgemm_w8a8_mxfp8_linear_with_fallback`.
- `mhc_mega_boundary` takes `y_fp8` / `y_gemm_sf` out-buffers; the Mega-mHC post fills them for the next layer's wqkv_a.
- The Mega wo_a `fp8_einsum` writes its FP8 output pair for wo_b.
- On whenever the layer can be prepared (Blackwell, DeepGEMM UE8M0, FlashInfer dense backend, aligned shapes); decode/verify only (no extend, no SP), at most 2048 rows. Every other linear is unchanged.

Ran the three registered GB300 accuracy tests on 4x GB300 at d463e2123d, as CI does (`cd test && python3 registered/e2e/models/<file>`):

| Test | GSM8K | MMMU-Pro |
|---|---:|---:|
| test_deepseek_v41_flash_gb300_tp4ep4 | 0.980 | 0.765 |
| test_deepseek_v41_flash_gb300_dp4ep4 | 0.985 | 0.770 |
| test_deepseek_v41_flash_gb300_encoder_bcg | 0.980 | 0.785 |

All `OK`. The fused wo_b path was active: each log shows the DeepGEMM JIT compile of the dense GEMM at wo_b's shape (N=5120, K=2048 under TP4, K=8192 under DP4), which nothing else triggers with `fp8_gemm_runner_backend=flashinfer_cutedsl`. The wqkv_a half only runs inside the Mega-mHC fused post (`SGLANG_OPT_DSV41_MEGA_MHC_PREFILL`), which no registered test sets.

The previous head 57860e4581 failed at weight load: `setup_mega_attention` runs inside `load_weights`, before the loader's `process_weights_after_loading` pass, so `block_fp8_mxfp8_ready` did not exist yet. d463e2123d moves the request to `LinearBase.deepgemm_mxfp8_input`, honoured by `Fp8LinearMethod.process_weights_after_loading`. Cancelled the queued GB300 CI rerun since this covers it; the unit and kernel reruns on d463e2123d passed.

@@ -26,13 +26,16 @@ def mhc_mega_boundary(
     hc_eps,
     norm_eps,
     sinkhorn_iters,
+    y_fp8=None,
+    y_gemm_sf=None,
 ):
     """Update the residual, collapse with carried pre, and compute next stats.
 
     The collapse uses ``pre`` from the preceding sublayer, not the new pre
     produced from the updated residual. Preserve this DSv4.1 shifted ordering.
     Used by the opt-in SM10x prefill path. Before CUDA graph capture, warm up
     on the capture stream to initialize DeepGEMM's per-stream barriers.
+    ``y_fp8`` / ``y_gemm_sf`` also receive the normed rows as a DeepGEMM MXFP8 pair.
     """
     rows, hidden = x.shape
     hc = residual.shape[1]
@@ -64,5 +67,7 @@ def mhc_mega_boundary(
         new_post_mix=next_post,
         new_comb_res_mix=next_comb,
         y_bf16=normalized,
+        y_fp8=y_fp8,
+        y_gemm_sf=y_gemm_sf,
     )
     return updated, normalized, (next_pre.squeeze(-1), next_post.squeeze(-1), next_comb)

@@ -265,6 +265,9 @@ def __init__(
             params_dtype = torch.get_default_dtype()
         self.params_dtype = params_dtype
         self.quant_config = quant_config
+        # A model sets this before weights load to ask for the DeepGEMM-packed
+        # MXFP8 input path; Fp8LinearMethod keeps it True only once prepared.
+        self.deepgemm_mxfp8_input = False
         if quant_config is None:
             from sglang.srt.layers.quantization.unquant import UnquantizedLinearMethod

@@ -62,13 +62,15 @@
     can_serve_block_fp8_as_mxfp8,
     cutlass_fp8_supported,
     deepgemm_w8a8_block_fp8_linear_with_fallback,
+    deepgemm_w8a8_mxfp8_linear_with_fallback,
     dense_mxscale_wanted,
     dispatch_block_fp8_mxfp8_linear,
     dispatch_w8a8_block_fp8_linear,
     dispatch_w8a8_mxfp8_linear,
     input_to_float8,
     mxfp8_group_quantize,
     normalize_e4m3fn_to_e4m3fnuz,
+    pack_mxfp8_weight_scale_for_deepgemm,
     prepare_xpu_block_scale_for_scaled_mm,
     requant_block_scale_ue8m0_for_deepgemm,
     resolve_block_fp8_mxfp8_backend,
@@ -968,6 +970,38 @@ def _prepare_block_fp8_as_mxfp8(self, layer: Module) -> None:
         self._process_mxfp8_linear_weight_scale(layer, scale_u8=scale_u8)
         layer.block_fp8_mxfp8_ready = True
 
+    def prepare_deepgemm_mxfp8_input(self, layer: Module) -> bool:
+        """Pack the weight scale a FlashInfer layer needs for a DeepGEMM-packed input pair."""
+        from sglang.srt.layers import deep_gemm_wrapper
+
+        backend = self.mxfp8_dense_backend
+        if not (
+            _is_cuda
+            and get_platform().is_blackwell
+            and backend is not None
+            and (backend.is_flashinfer_cutedsl() or backend.is_flashinfer_cutlass())
+            and deep_gemm_wrapper.ENABLE_JIT_DEEPGEMM
+            and deep_gemm_wrapper.DEEPGEMM_SCALE_UE8M0
+        ):
+            return False
+        n, k = layer.weight.shape
+        if n % 64 != 0 or k % 128 != 0:
+            return False
+        if self.use_mxfp8:
+            scale_u8 = layer.weight_scale_inv.data.view(torch.uint8).reshape(n, k // 32)
+        elif self.block_fp8_as_mxfp8 and layer.block_fp8_mxfp8_ready:
+            scale_u8 = block_fp8_scale_to_mxfp8_e8m0(
+                layer.weight_scale_inv.data, (n, k), self.weight_block_size
+            )
+        else:
+            return False
+        copy_or_rebind_param(
+            layer,
+            "weight_scale_inv_deepgemm",
+            pack_mxfp8_weight_scale_for_deepgemm(scale_u8, n, k),
+        )
+        return True
+
     def _process_mxfp8_linear_weight_scale(

issue_comments.body:
(codex)

- **P1 — Weight reload:** [fp8_utils.py:1022](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/10f0f3b498de3e257f69f7da1db43fd54c56a45c/python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/fp8_utils.py#L1022) replaces the packed-scale tensor, leaving captured CUDA graphs using old scales. Use `copy_or_rebind_param` to refresh the existing storage.
- **P2 — Native MXFP8:** [fp8.py:791](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/10f0f3b498de3e257f69f7da1db43fd54c56a45c/python/sglang/srt/layers/quantization/fp8.py#L791) returns without preparing the DeepGEMM scales, so the fusion never activates for native MXFP8. Prepare them on this path too.
- **Drop the manual script:** it bypasses production loading/dispatch and only prints reference errors. It can even report PASS for NaN outputs: `max(0.0, nan, nan) == 0.0`.

Source review only; GPU numerics/performance were not run.
